explication: Trix is a browser-based rich-text editor. Its core workflow is user input through the custom editor and toolbar, controller-mediated edits to an internal document/composition, then rendering and serialization to HTML or form values. It also manages embedded attachments and provides an inspector with recording playback. The graph reflects documented capabilities and sampled call ownership; some unsampled feature wiring is intentionally omitted.
